description: collapse duplicated index-creation blocks between alembic versions 004/006 and 008/013
reason: Alembic migrations are an immutable historical record, not code. Two migrations that create indexes the same way are Type-0 resemblance -- the shape is the framework's grammar. Editing an applied migration desynchronises every deployed database from its recorded revision.

description: deduplicate Svelte CSS and markup clones across frontend routes and components
reason: Out of verifiable scope. The baseline covers Python only (533 pytest tests); the frontend's sole test script is 'node tests/smoke.mjs', which the harness does not parse. Any frontend edit would be unverifiable by construction. Revisit if a real frontend suite is wired into the baseline.

description: delete tests/test_backup.py as an orphaned version file
reason: False positive. The orphan-version-file probe matches a trailing '_backup' segment, but test_backup.py is the live test module for the backup service, not an abandoned copy. Probe over-matches on 'backup' as a domain word.

description: strip obvious and narration comments from invoice_machine and tests
reason: Probe over-promised: 26 hits, ~2 genuine. Breakdown after reading every site: ~14 are test section markers ('# Create a client') that aid readability in long test bodies; 6 are alembic comments explaining migration idempotency (also out of scope as immutable history); payments.py:184 is a WHY comment documenting an IntegrityError race and must be kept; crypto.py:148 and backup.py:262 sit above dense expressions where the comment earns its line. Only api/clients.py:218 '# Get the restored client' is truly redundant. value 1 x confidence 1.0 / risk 1 = 1.0, below the 1.5 threshold. Not worth a commit.

description: extract the repeated invoice-and-client setup fixture in tests/test_pdf.py
reason: UNVERIFIABLE on this host. tests/test_pdf.py carries a module-level skipif for missing WeasyPrint/GTK native libs, so all its tests skip here -- it is the '1 skipped' in the baseline. The clone is real (a 4-deep patch stack repeated across 5 tests, ~90 lines), but a skipped module is invisible to verify.py: breaking all five tests would still report ISOMORPHIC. Revisit under WSL/Docker or after installing the GTK runtime, where the module actually executes.
